esi_scale.2: Emergent - high risk situation, severe pain/distress
esi_scale.3: Urgent - stable but needs multiple resources

pathways.name: Acute Coronary Syndrome
pathways.evidence: Chest pain/pressure with radiation, diaphoresis or dyspnea is consistent with Acute Coronary Syndrome (ICD-10 I21.9). Standard protocol places this at ESI-2 pending ECG and troponin.

pathways.name: Acute Ischemic Stroke
pathways.evidence: Sudden focal neurological deficit (facial droop, slurred speech, unilateral weakness) meets FAST stroke criteria. Time-critical, ESI-1.

pathways.name: Sepsis / Severe Infection
pathways.evidence: Fever with altered mentation and hemodynamic instability meets qSOFA-suggestive criteria for sepsis. ESI-2, requires rapid antibiotics/fluids.

pathways.name: Anaphylaxis / Severe Allergic Reaction
pathways.evidence: Airway/breathing compromise with allergic trigger indicates anaphylaxis. Immediate epinephrine protocol, ESI-1.

pathways.name: Severe Trauma / Hemorrhage
pathways.evidence: Mechanism of injury and active hemorrhage or unresponsiveness indicate major trauma. ESI-1, trauma team activation.

pathways.name: Acute Asthma / Respiratory Distress
pathways.evidence: Wheezing with dyspnea suggests acute asthma exacerbation. ESI-3 unless severe respiratory failure signs present.

pathways.name: Diabetic Emergency (DKA/Hypoglycemia)
pathways.evidence: Altered mentation with known/suspected glycemic derangement requires urgent glucose correction. ESI-2.

pathways.name: Acute Abdomen / Appendicitis
pathways.evidence: Localized abdominal pain with nausea/fever is consistent with acute appendicitis pathway. ESI-3, surgical consult likely.

pathways.name: Extremity Fracture
pathways.evidence: Deformity/pain after fall suggests fracture requiring imaging and splinting. ESI-4.

pathways.name: Migraine / Headache
pathways.evidence: Headache with photophobia and no focal neuro deficit is consistent with migraine. ESI-4.

pathways.name: Urinary Tract Infection
pathways.evidence: Dysuria and urinary frequency without systemic signs is a routine UTI presentation. ESI-4.

pathways.name: Minor Laceration / Wound
pathways.evidence: Superficial wound without active major bleeding requires minimal resources. ESI-5.

pathways.name: Pediatric Fever
pathways.evidence: Fever in a young child warrants prompt evaluation given higher deterioration risk. ESI-3.

pathways.name: Psychiatric Crisis / Suicidal Ideation
pathways.evidence: Expressed suicidal ideation requires urgent psychiatric safety evaluation. ESI-2, 1:1 observation indicated.

pathways.name: Mild Allergic Reaction
pathways.evidence: Localized skin reaction without airway or systemic involvement is low acuity. ESI-4.

pathways.name: Low Back Pain
pathways.evidence: Mechanical low back pain without red-flag neuro signs is non-urgent. ESI-5.

red_flag_rules.name: Cardiac + Diaphoresis
red_flag_rules.message: Deterministic override: chest pain combined with diaphoresis/dyspnea/radiation triggers immediate ACS escalation regardless of AI confidence.

red_flag_rules.name: Stroke FAST Criteria
red_flag_rules.message: Deterministic override: FAST-positive neurological deficit triggers immediate stroke escalation.

red_flag_rules.name: Airway Compromise
red_flag_rules.message: Deterministic override: airway compromise with allergic trigger forces anaphylaxis protocol.

red_flag_rules.name: Uncontrolled Hemorrhage / Unresponsive
red_flag_rules.message: Deterministic override: active major hemorrhage or unresponsiveness forces trauma-1 activation.

red_flag_rules.name: Active Suicidal Plan
red_flag_rules.message: Deterministic override: expressed active suicidal plan/intent forces immediate 1:1 psychiatric safety observation.
